newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indosat to discuss accounting rate.
newsitem.headline: Indosat to discuss accounting rate.

text.p: Indonesia international telecommunications provider PT Indosat said on Tuesday its accounting rate would be one of the topics discussed at an analysts' meeting it is holding today.
Indosat's investor relations manager Budi Prasetyo said the company would also include the collection rate and some indications of its year-end performance at the meeting.
The company's senior management will conduct the meeting at the company's headquarters at 3 p.m. (0800 GMT).
Prasetyo said Indosat planned to give details on the impact of a recent proposal from the U.S. Federal Communications Commission to speed up changes in the accounting rate.

Indosat said in a statement on December 2 that the U.S. FCC proposal that Indonesia's accounting rate to the United States be reduced to $1.30 per minute from January 1 from the current $1.40 would have little effect on its revenue.
